subject: FinOps pathway and timeline to switch HelionTech to Marketplace billing
messages:
From: Amara Jones <amara.jones@heliontech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@heliontech.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming renewal + ask to move to AWS Marketplace billing

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from our finance team — HelionTech's subscription with Redwood is up for renewal on 2027-06-01. Our procurement team is pushing us to consolidate all purchases through AWS Marketplace to simplify PO flow and get consolidated invoicing.

Can you share what the minimum steps and timeline look like to convert our direct invoice to Marketplace billing? Procurement also asked whether the SKU entitlements will match the current seat/commit terms, and whether switching impacts contract terms or SLA.

We can provide a PO immediately if that helps.

Thanks,
Amara Jones
Head of Cloud Finance
HelionTech

Attachment: Helion_Request_Details.xlsx (referred, not attached in this thread)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Amara Jones <amara.jones@heliontech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + ask to move to AWS Marketplace billing

Hi Amara — thanks for the heads up and that this is a procurement priority. We’ve migrated a number of customers to Marketplace billing; we typically follow a 2–3 week cutover timeline once we have the signed PO + entitlement mapping confirmed. High level:

- Step 1: Confirm PO and current SKU/commit mapping (we need to map your existing plan to our Marketplace listing SKUs).
- Step 2: Create a Marketplace amendment (DocuSign) that authorizes Marketplace invoicing for the committed period.
- Step 3: Enable entitlements in AWS Marketplace and sync billing; we issue a final direct invoice prorating any overlap and then all future invoices come through Marketplace.
- Step 4: Validate in your billing console and confirm next invoice date.

Impact on terms/SLA: the commercial terms (pricing and commit) remain the same for the term covered by the amendment; Marketplace terms add the marketplace purchase flow but do not change our SLA. I’ll loop in Ben (Sales Ops) to prepare the amendment draft and Grace (CS) to coordinate the validation window.

If you can send the PO today, we can target a cutover on 2027-05-28.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Amara Jones <amara.jones@heliontech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace amendment draft & entitlement checklist

Hi all — looped in per Naomi. I’ve attached a draft amendment that we typically use to switch billing to AWS Marketplace; it includes an entitlement mapping worksheet for your finance team to confirm SKU equivalencies.

Key notes:
- We will set the amendment effective date to the next invoice cycle you indicate (default: 2027-06-01).
- If HelionTech provides a PO covering the remaining term, we can have the DocuSign envelope ready within 48 hours.
- Once signed, our marketplace enablement team requests up to 5 business days to provision entitlements and complete the billing sync.

Amara — can you confirm who will sign the amendment on HelionTech's side (Finance director or procurement head)? Also please confirm whether HelionTech requires Redwood to be listed as a vendor under any specific legal clause for marketplace purchases — we can add a short rider if needed.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Marketplace amendment draft & entitlement checklist

Thanks Ben — procurement has prepared a PO (attached). Our procurement head, Lisa Moreno, will sign the amendment. We do not need extra vendor clauses beyond standard Marketplace terms.

PO attached: Helion_PO_20270512.pdf

Questions from procurement:
- Will switching to Marketplace preserve our current committed capacity and pricing tiers?
- Do we need to change any API keys or tokens in our integration? (We use the hosted Redwood API directly today.)

Cc'ing AWS Partner Manager to ensure there are no Marketplace-side enrollment blockers.

Best,
Amara

Attachment: Helion_PO_20270512.pdf (application/pdf, 124 KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Amara Jones <amara.jones@heliontech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, AWS Partner Manager <aws_pm@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace amendment draft & entitlement checklist

Hi Amara — great, thanks for the PO and confirmation. Quick answers and next steps:

- Pricing/commits: confirmed — the amendment will carry over your current committed capacity and pricing tiers for the remainder of the term. The Marketplace SKU mapping in the attachment will reflect equivalent entitlement units.
- Integration/API: no changes required to your runtime API keys. Marketplace billing only changes the invoicing path; your application-facing credentials and endpoints remain the same. We will not rotate keys as part of the billing migration.

Next steps we will execute:
1) Ben will upload the PO and finalize the DocuSign envelope (he’s done that just now). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-ENV-998877
2) Once Lisa signs (procurement), we’ll submit the enablement request to AWS Marketplace. Provisioning window: up to 5 business days.
3) We’ll issue a final direct invoice that prorates any overlap and then confirm first Marketplace invoice date.
4) Grace will follow up post-cutover to validate billing in your console and confirm the first invoice.

Target cutover: 2027-05-28 (assuming signed amendment by 2027-05-17). If procurement needs longer, tell us your target and we’ll adjust the amendment effective date.

Ben/Grace — can you confirm once DocuSign is sent and then once AWS has provisioned? I’ll update the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
